system.description:
You gain a special [inventory slot]20. You may freely place items into this [inventory slot]. When your rest time ends or you command it, this [inventory slot] will vanish along with the items stored inside, and the items will no longer be accessible during afterplay, nor will they be affected by external influences. A mysterious vault ticket that allows you to deposit your items in a vault that appears anywhere. While your items are deposited, no one knows where they are.

Star Weasel Tail [Core Material] (560G) + Crow's Handbag (600G) + [Magic Catalyst 17] (280G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (700G)
